main_text.l: quid, & quid non pugnet cum jure Divino,
illud imprimis commendet observandum &
arctè tenendum; Deo potius esse obtemperan-
dum quàm hominibus. Cum, inquam, tam la-
tè pateat officium Pastorum Evangelicorum;
altrinsecus Deus in terris, omnem personam,
omnes lites, leges, dicenda, agenda, de quacumque
re aut negotio, in quocunque loco, tempo-
re & coetu hominum, judicio, quod præci-
pit, mandat, jubet, cogit & punit, subjece-
rit cognitioni & imperio Magistratus, non Ec-
clesiastici (cujus altum est silentium in sacro
codice) sed civilis & Politici; inde conficitur
Papam, quatenus exercet imperium extra ter-
ritorium suum in Reges & populos, catenus
imperium terrenum Jurisdictionemque civi-
lem & Politicam exercere, consimilem pote-
stati Magistratûs; nec nisi ad fucum facien-
dum (& ne dispalescat imperium Papæ
terrenum) fucari & obduci, vocabulis Ecclesia-
stici & Spiritualis.
CAPUT

page.notes: The heading "CAPUT" is printed without a number; the caput attribute is therefore given as 4 only by inference from the running title, which is uncertain. Long s rendered as s throughout. The page contains ink specks and show-through only otherwise; the "Digitized by Google" credit is omitted.
